---
title: "Separate SOS and genomic-diversity associations with cleaning performance"
format: html
editor: source
---

Outcome and frozen normalization are unchanged. SOS scope is the fixed14biofilm
candidate MAGs, using all tested SOS_response genes in each, without selecting
SOS genes by significance. A MAG with no SOS annotation is unavailable, not zero.
Compute mean gene-centred log2CPM using full-library effective sizes and prior0.5,
as for biofilm scores. This is not per-cell activity or UV-specific resistance.

Genomic scope is the existing five-MAG coverage-qualified dataset, NOT the14MAG
candidate set. Only MAG-phase combinations with all six samples passing the
existing >=5x mean coverage and >=0.5 callable-breadth rules are eligible.
Use reported callable-weighted nucleotide diversity, with no imputation or
substitution of pairwise distances. Require complete finite predictor values.
Coverage and strain mixture can affect diversity. No damage/mutation-rate claim.

Each eligible MAG-phase gets score~condition+x, score~factor(cycle)+condition+x,
and score~cycle+condition+x. Genomics additionally gets score~condition+x+
log10_coverage. No joint SOS/diversity fit. Two-sided OLS and HC3 approximate
t tests, BH across all tests within each evidence layer; also across all tests.
These post hoc exploratory models assume independent errors despite repeated
membranes, condition/membrane confounding and fixed constructed scores. No
calibrated treatment-effect inference. Model df and coverage sensitivity reported.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(edgeR)})
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
paths<-c(score=file.path(root,"cleaning_performance_score_2026-09-14-v1/cleaning_score.rds"),
 candidates=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_condition_models_2026-09-14-v1/models.tsv"),
 membership=file.path(root,"mag_functional_concentration_combined_2026-09-13-v1/tables/membership_and_original_statistics.tsv.gz"),
 counts=file.path(root,"full_transcriptome_de/tables/collapsed_raw_count_matrix.tsv"),
 libs=file.path(root,"full_transcriptome_de/tables/library_sizes_and_normalization.tsv"),
 genomic=file.path(root,"manuscript_candidates/tables/mag_genomic_variation_sample_qc.tsv"))
sha<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256");before<-vapply(paths,sha,character(1))
score<-readRDS(paths['score'])$scores
cand<-unique(fread(paths['candidates'])[,.(MAG_ID,genus)])
m<-fread(paths['membership'])[set_id=="SOS_response" & MAG_ID %in% cand$MAG_ID]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(m$feature_id))
libs<-fread(paths['libs']);samples<-libs$sample_title
counts<-fread(paths['counts'],select=c("feature_id",samples))
counts<-counts[match(m$feature_id,feature_id)];stopifnot(identical(counts$feature_id,m$feature_id))
lcpm<-cpm(as.matrix(counts[,..samples]),lib.size=libs$effective_library_size,log=TRUE,prior.count=.5)
centred<-lcpm-rowMeans(lcpm)
s<-as.data.table(centred);setnames(s,samples);s[,MAG_ID:=m$MAG_ID]
s<-s[,lapply(.SD,mean),by=MAG_ID,.SDcols=samples]
s<-melt(s,id.vars="MAG_ID",variable.name="sample_title",value.name="x")
s<-merge(s,libs[,.(sample_title,condition,phase,cycle)],by="sample_title")
s<-merge(s,cand,by="MAG_ID");s[,layer:="SOS"]
membership_summary<-m[,.(n_SOS_genes=.N,n_condition_up=sum(FDR<.05 & logFC>0),
 n_condition_down=sum(FDR<.05 & logFC<0)),by=MAG_ID]
eligibility<-merge(cand,membership_summary,by="MAG_ID",all.x=TRUE)
eligibility[,SOS_available:=!is.na(n_SOS_genes)]
q<-fread(paths['genomic'])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(q[,.(MAG_ID,condition,phase,cycle)]))
q[,usable:=sample_passes_qc & mean_coverage>=5 & callable_breadth>=.5 & is.finite(nucleotide_diversity)]
gqc<-q[,.(qualified=sum(usable),observed=.N),by=.(MAG_ID,phase)]
eligible<-gqc[qualified==6 & observed==6,.(MAG_ID,phase)]
g<-q[eligible,on=.(MAG_ID,phase)]
g[,`:=`(x=nucleotide_diversity,layer="heterogeneity",log10_coverage=log10(mean_coverage))]
z<-rbindlist(list(s,g[,.(MAG_ID,genus,condition,phase,cycle,x,layer,log10_coverage)]),fill=TRUE)
z<-merge(z,score[,.(condition,cycle,score)],by=c("condition","cycle"),allow.cartesian=TRUE)
keys<-unique(z[,.(MAG_ID,phase,layer)])
results<-list();observations<-list();fits<-list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(keys))){
 k<-keys[i];d<-copy(z[k,on=.(MAG_ID,phase,layer)]);setorder(d,condition,cycle)
 d[,condition:=factor(condition)]
 forms<-list(condition_only=score~condition+x,categorical_cycle=score~factor(cycle)+condition+x,
 linear_cycle=score~cycle+condition+x)
 if(k$layer=="heterogeneity")forms$coverage_adjusted<-score~condition+x+log10_coverage
 for(spec in names(forms)){
  f<-lm(forms[[spec]],d);X<-model.matrix(f);df<-df.residual(f)
  stopifnot(nrow(d)==6,f$rank==ncol(X),df>0)
  b<-unname(coef(f)['x']);se<-sqrt(vcov(f)['x','x']);h<-hatvalues(f)
  stopifnot(all(h<1-1e-10))
  V<-solve(crossprod(X));hc<-V%*%crossprod(X,X*as.numeric((resid(f)/(1-h))^2))%*%V
  se3<-sqrt(hc['x','x'])
  nuisance<-X[,colnames(X)!="x",drop=FALSE]
  rx<-lm.fit(nuisance,d$x)$residuals;ry<-lm.fit(nuisance,d$score)$residuals
  stopifnot(abs(b-sum(rx*ry)/sum(rx^2))<1e-7*max(1,abs(b)))
  key<-paste(k$layer,k$MAG_ID,k$phase,spec,sep="/")
  fits[[key]]<-f
  results[[key]]<-data.table(layer=k$layer,MAG_ID=k$MAG_ID,genus=d$genus[1],phase=k$phase,
   specification=spec,n=6,residual_df=df,beta=b,se=se,p=2*pt(-abs(b/se),df),
   low=b-qt(.975,df)*se,high=b+qt(.975,df)*se,HC3_p=2*pt(-abs(b/se3),df),
   beta_per_predictor_SD=b*sd(d$x),max_leverage=max(h))
  dd<-copy(d);dd[,`:=`(specification=spec,fitted=fitted(f),residual=resid(f))];observations[[key]]<-dd
 }
}
a<-rbindlist(results)
a[,`:=`(FDR_layer=p.adjust(p,"BH"),HC3_FDR_layer=p.adjust(HC3_p,"BH")),by=layer]
a[,`:=`(FDR_all=p.adjust(p,"BH"),HC3_FDR_all=p.adjust(HC3_p,"BH"))]
stopifnot(identical(before,vapply(paths,sha,character(1))))
dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
for(n in c("models","observations","SOS_eligibility","genomic_eligibility","SOS_gene_membership")){
 obj<-switch(n,models=a,observations=rbindlist(observations),SOS_eligibility=eligibility,
 genomic_eligibility=gqc,SOS_gene_membership=m)
 fwrite(obj,file.path(out,paste0(n,".tsv")),sep="\t")
}
saveRDS(fits,file.path(out,"fits.rds"))
paths<-c(paths,notebook=Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"))
fwrite(data.table(path=paths,sha256=vapply(paths,sha,character(1))),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
file.copy(paths['notebook'],file.path(out,basename(paths['notebook'])))
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,"sessionInfo.txt"))
writeLines(c("PASS: all fits full rank with six rows; independent FWL slopes; unchanged inputs.",
 "SOS gene scores use all annotated tested SOS genes per candidate; missing annotations not zero.",
 "Genomic models use separate existing coverage-qualified MAG set, not biofilm candidates."),file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
print(a[,.(tests=.N,raw=sum(p<.05),BH=sum(FDR_layer<.05),min_p=min(p),min_FDR=min(FDR_layer)),by=layer])
print(a[layer=="heterogeneity",.(MAG_ID,phase,specification,beta,p,FDR_layer)])
print(a[layer=="SOS"][order(p)][1:5,.(MAG_ID,phase,specification,beta,p,FDR_layer)])
```
